# ifdefined

Checks the type. *(version 4.46 or later)*

```ttl
ifdefined <var>
```

## Remarks

Sets the type of &lt;var&gt;. One of the following values in the system variable "result":

<table>
 <tr>
  <th>Value</th>
  <th>Meaning</th>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>0</td>
  <td>undefined</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>1</td>
  <td>integer</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>3</td>
  <td>string</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>4</td>
  <td>label</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>5</td>
  <td>integer array</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>6</td>
  <td>string array</td>
 </tr>
</table>

## Example

```ttl
ifdefined data
int2str valstr result
messagebox valstr 'variable type'
```
